final_goal.text: Agents propose a design, an evaluator scores it, agents revise; repeat until the target is met
final_goal.done_when: Written into the milestones below by the core coordinators

milestones.title: Evaluator scores one real design end to end
milestones.done_when: One design from the benchmark set is scored; an independent review agrees with the numbers

milestones.title: Benchmark set frozen
milestones.done_when: Benchmark list and expected outputs committed; a held-out part is kept outside every repository

milestones.title: Closed loop improves a design
milestones.done_when: The agent revises a design using evaluator feedback and the score improves on the held-out part
